reviewer_model: opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro (flash reviewer not yet loaded in-session)
scope: The F3 composed-tape verification seam and its three capture collaborators: ReplayTapeDataCapture, ReplayTapeManifestProducer, ReplayTapeManifestCapture, and the opaque ComposedReplayTape issued only after verifying the outer manifest bytes, the inner prior manifest-producer data receipt, and the separate replay-data receipt. This is what makes the P7 tape_manifest/tape_data descriptors resolve to verified PUBLISHED/CAPTURED identities and closes P7's verification half.
non_goals: the runnable R1 ReplayRun broker (start_ms/feed_results/id_allocations runtime tape)
F1/F2 EventEnvelope causal reordering; the full F3 feed/roster data-capture lane
deriving ordered_envelope_digests from a real feed (digests are supplied; the codec already verifies internal consistency)
open_questions_to_skeptic: Q1: which capture model exposes the member bytes the composed-tape seam reads? The v1 open_capture -> VerifiedCapture path reads PUBLISHED members but forbids a second capture of the data root; the P4 commit_p4_batch path (ADR-0128) allows multi-consumer capture but returns only an opaque CapturedAuthorizationRecord with no member-read seam. A coherent seam must name where the manifest inner bytes and the two receipt digests come from.
Q2: what minimal read-only trust.py accessor is needed for the CAPTURED receipt digest, and is it nonauthorizing?
Q3: where do the three collaborators live given the purity rule (pipeline never imports production) and bundles.py's base+vocab-only import pin?

proposed_design.location: new module dskit/production/replay_tape.py (production-side; imports dskit.pipeline.trust public names and the bundles.CapturedReplayTape codec). bundles.py keeps only the codec.

collaborators.ReplayTapeDataCapture: opaque collaborator binding the parent data PUBLISH root (its VerifiedCapture/descriptor) whose root is PUBLISHED.

collaborators.ReplayTapeManifestProducer: opaque collaborator for the distinct later consumer that consumes the data capture, derives the inner CapturedReplayTape.v1 bytes (codec _build), and PUBLISHES them in its own manifest root.

collaborators.ReplayTapeManifestCapture: opaque collaborator binding the manifest producer's PUBLISH root (the outer manifest identity).

collaborators.ComposedReplayTape: opaque capability issued only after verification; the only object that may become a runtime ReplayTape; no public constructor/copy/pickle.

proposed_design.verification: compose_replay_tape(manifest_capture, data_capture, replay_data_receipt) verifies: (1) the manifest inner CapturedReplayTape.v1 bytes parse and recompute; (2) inner data_capture_root equals the data PUBLISH identity; (3) inner data_captured_receipt equals the retained manifest-producer CAPTURED receipt for that data root; (4) inner source_rank_policy_sha256 equals the consumed roster policy pin; (5) the separate replay-data CAPTURED receipt equals the retained replay receipt for the data port. Only then issues ComposedReplayTape.
proposed_design.receipt_accessor: a read-only, nonauthorizing accessor on the trust authority exposing the retained CAPTURED receipt digest for a captured publication, refusing unless CAPTURED.

cases: manifest root recorded in its own inner bytes
replay-data receipt against the wrong port
policy derived from a resulting tape

compatibility.purity: pipeline never imports production; the new module is production-side; the receipt accessor in trust.py is stdlib-only and nonauthorizing.
compatibility.p4_p6: no change to the codec, the descriptor grammar, or the P4/P6 capture semantics; the multi-consumer capture (ADR-0128) is unchanged.

forbidden_effects: minting authority from the codec or collaborators
any capture/lifecycle transition from a read-only verification

tests.new: tests/production/test_composed_replay_tape.py: positive data-publish -> manifest-producer capture -> manifest publish -> compose -> composed tape; codec/hierarchy/receipt/policy/capability negative families; synthetic F4/P4 fixtures only.

implementation_files: dskit/pipeline/trust.py (one read-only nonauthorizing CAPTURED receipt-digest accessor)
